target_customer: Tech and software companies that want creator ads and sponsorships (current site); enterprise and mid-market brands (YC description)
problem: Creator marketing is bought on reach and is hard to attribute; Beluga sources creators, negotiates, contracts, pays and tracks results so spend behaves like measurable paid ads.
business_model: Managed service fee of 20 percent of creator ad spend or creator pay, from $15K per month, month to month (per company site)
product_category: Creator marketing agency with in-house software

competitors.name: CreatorIQ
competitors.what: Enterprise creator marketing software for governance, analytics and large campaigns
competitors.traction_then: Positioned by comparison blogs as the enterprise default

competitors.name: GRIN, Aspire, Captiv8 and similar platforms
competitors.what: Influencer marketing software suites listed as alternatives to each other

technical_complexity.rationale: Campaign sourcing, contracting and payment tooling is standard software plus operations; the current offering is an agency with internal tooling, so the hard part is operations rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Many platforms and agencies sell the same service and no data or network effect is shown; the edge is execution and results claims.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sourced evidence of incumbents copying or buying Beluga; established platforms already offered end to end creator campaign tooling.

market_need_then: Vendor blogs cite a global influencer marketing market of about $32.55 billion in 2025 and a shift to managed, attributable creator programs; the figure is a secondary estimate.

identity.mascot_or_character: None found; site uses water themed section labels
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, direct, results focused; short declarative copy

branding.community_and_virality: No press on the brand itself found; search results mix in other companies named Beluga

brand_strength.rationale: Short memorable word but no brand assets or coverage; other companies and products share the name.

pivots.from: YC listing described a fully managed AI creator marketing platform (a search snippet also described a creator finance back office; unreconciled)
pivots.to: Site now describes a creator marketing agency with in-house software

outcome_analysis: Beluga is active and early. The company page now describes an agency that charges 20 percent on creator ad spend or creator pay from $15K a month and lists named software startup clients, with case studies reported by the company itself. No funding round, exit or failure evidence was found, so the outcome is still open and no strong success or failure factor can be assigned from sources.
notes: Unverified: aggregators (VC Backed, startup intelligence profile) list $500K pre-seed in 2025, consistent with the standard YC deal but not confirmed by a primary source, and one aggregator mixes it with a different Beluga Labs. CB Insights lists a 2023 seed that likely belongs to another company. Competitors come from undated-to-2025 vendor listicles. The batch is Spring 2025 per YC.
